hero.description: The tower of the Second Court, leading towards the Third Court of St John's College, Cambridge, England. Statue of Mary Talbot, Countess of Shrewsbury (1556–1632) the wife of Gilbert Talbot, 7th Earl of Shrewsbury . A white marble copy of this statue depicts Lady Rachel Fane (Countess of Bath) in Tawstock Church, Devon.
